attributes.title: SGO 2027 Annual Meeting on Gynecologic Cancer
attributes.series: SGO Annual Meeting on Gynecologic Cancer
attributes.summary:
Gynecologic oncologists meet at the Phoenix Convention Center on March 19 to 22, 2027. The science centers on clinical trials and new therapeutics. Candidates for the certifying exam can add early-morning board roundtables, and Friday masterclasses on coding, high-stakes procedures and communication carry separate small fees.

The registration page notes that guest badges carry no CE credit, which implies credit for other categories, but the credit total is not published yet. Most fees appear only in an image we could not verify, so we list none. Refunds less $100 are available through March 5, 2027.
